source_verification_receipts.locator: Publisher metadata/abstract; theorem text was inaccessible through the journal endpoint
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The journal article exists as cited and describes pointwise and uniform distance-based BDD estimation/inference plus minimax lower bounds for isotropic regression estimators. Exact theorem-number comparisons should continue to cite the archived proceedings PDF or the May-2026 arXiv version alongside the journal version.
The accessible companion version states minimax lower bounds for a broad class of nonparametric isotropic regression estimators; it does not describe a floor-rounded radial observation experiment.

The paper identifies the latent scalar RD effect under polynomial conditional means and known within-cell rounding-error moments, using an invertible triangular moment map; it is not a nonparametric radial-bin minimax result.

The article studies discrete-running-variable RD, rejects clustering-by-score as a misspecification remedy, and proposes two coverage-guaranteed alternatives under restrictions on the conditional mean.
The paper derives finite-sample optimal confidence intervals and sharp efficiency bounds for linear functionals over convex regression classes, including an RD specialization.
The paper constructs bias-aware honest intervals for scalar nonparametric targets using kernel or local-polynomial estimators and derivative-bounded classes.
